title: After eighteen years of jaggedy bowling, a new mod bestows GTA 4 with DLSS and FSR support
summary: GTA IV – no, not VI, sorry – can now get a modern, sharper-looking DLSS or FSR makeover with a new upscaling mod.

Home News Grand Theft Auto IV After eighteen years of jaggedy bowling, a new mod bestows GTA 4 with DLSS and FSR support Get with the times Image credit: Rockstar Games / Rockstar North News by James Archer Deputy Editor Published on Sept. 24, 2026, 10:30 a.m. 1 comment Follow Grand Theft Auto IV Rockstar's modding guidelines , recently updated in advance of GTA 6 , say much about how you can't dream up unofficial story missions, or give the upcoming instalment a cheeky unofficial PC port. But they don't say a goddamn thing about crowbarring DLSS, DLAA, and FSR into 2008's Grand Theft Auto IV , which is exactly what ChunkLeChuck's DLSS IV mod has gone and done. This isn't the first time modders have got Nvidia and/or AMD's anti-aliasing upscaler replacements into GTA 4; Warcaco's RTX Remix mod had DLSS working as part of a wider suite of high-rez texture and path tracing additions. DLSS IV, though, looks like the much lighter, quicker, cleaner fix if you just want to give a modern makeover to the base game's infamously jagged and shimmering attempt at AA. GTA IV Now Supports DLSS Watch on YouTube Dull technical reminder: DLSS is Nvidia's machine-learned upscaler for GeForce RTX graphics cards, while DLAA is basically DLSS's anti-aliasing component without the upscaling. The mod's chosen version of FSR, AMD's equivalent, appears to be FSR 3, so it's not quite as pin-sharp as Nvidia's cleverer tech but should work on any functional GPU from any manufacturer. Any of these three will give Liberty City's edges a nice sand-and-varnish, and are compatible with HDR. DLAA's lack of upscaling means it won't have the same performance-massaging effect as DLSS or FSR, but I'm guessing that if you're interested in modding GTA 4 in 2026, it's because you're already playing GTA 4 in 2026, which means your PC can already run GTA 4 in 2026. Also, look, this game is older than most GTA 6 players will be. Your RTX 3060 will be fine. Allegedly, Rockstar were considered a full, modernising remaster of GTA 4 as recently as 2022, but (also allegedly) binned the idea after the launch of Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition . Player and critical response to this remastered bundle was largely unenthusiastic, on the grounds that it was massive bum .
